# Ligue 1 - PSG v Lyon, Mon Oct 26

Level on 14 pts (Lyon top on GD). PSG out: Dembele, Marquinhos, Nuno Mendes, Kvaratskhelia. Lyon out: Openda, Ouedraogo, Tagliafico; Nakamura suspended; Sulc and Kango doubts.

Market PSG ~71% (1.40); SportyTrader model 57.3% - a 14-point gap, above our ~10-point trust cap for top leagues, so no Lyon bet. Over 2.5 at 1.38 vs model 72.3% = no edge. BTTS Yes (model 79% vs 1.62 ~62%, last 7 H2H BTTS) is the most interesting angle but the gap is too large to trust and BTTS is not a tracked market. Pass.
